Lenovo announced the highly performant ThinkSystem SR685a V3 8GPU server with AMD Instinct MI300X for both enterprise on-premise AI and public AI cloud service providers.
HP and Lenovo announced new enterprise PCs powered by Ryzen PRO 8000 Series processors.
